offering_description.value: Develops and sells network security hardware and software, including firewalls, secure networking (SD-WAN), cloud and endpoint security, and security operations tools, to enterprises, service providers and governments. Delivered as appliances, virtual software and cloud subscriptions, built on in-house security chips and a unified operating system.

primary_products.value: firewall appliances; secure SD-WAN and networking equipment; endpoint and cloud security software; security operations software; email and web security

primary_services.value: security subscriptions and threat intelligence; technical support; professional services and training; cloud-delivered security

customer_segment.value: B2B: enterprises, small businesses, managed security service providers, telecom carriers; B2G: government agencies and public sector organizations

end_markets.value: enterprise IT; telecommunications; government; financial services; healthcare; education; retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: firewall and networking appliances and perpetual software; subscription: security subscriptions, cloud and SaaS services; service fees: technical support, professional services and training

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs security appliances with in-house chips, built by contract manufacturers, sold via channel partners; software / platform: security software and cloud platform sold to enterprises and service providers; service provider: support and threat intelligence services for customers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: network security, secure networking, cloud security and security operations on one platform

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: value-added distributors selling to resellers; partners / resellers: resellers, system integrators and managed security service providers; direct sales: large enterprise and carrier accounts
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; partners / resellers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy, export controls and government security certifications such as FedRAMP and Common Criteria
